text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having vowed to revive the derelict 
shrine, 
No Reason returned with me today to take 
the 
first step toward that goal, but—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *pant*... A-At last... we've 
finally finished 
clearing the approach and the stairs...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaha, we broke a fine sweat! Maintaining 
the roads 
is paramount if prosperity is to follow!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
It certainly is much easier to climb now, 
but... 
Do you really think anyone will actually 
bother 
coming all the way up here in the first 
place...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I have already laid the groundwork 
for that! 
Consider this our "first volley"!

text_block_list.name: Local Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? "Tracen Academy Recommended: 
Special Training Challenge Course"? 
Was that always here?

text_block_list.name: Local Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
"Features an uphill route scaling the 
slope to the shrine"... 
Hmm. Maybe I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Local Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me make it to the URA—! 
All right! Time to run even harder!
choice_data_list:
More and more horsegirls are showing up to 
run!

More and more horsegirls are showing up to 
run!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, well? It may be just a tiny 
sprout, 
but dost thou not see a ray of hope?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'm... really so happy. 
To think local girls are actually visiting 
here... 
.........

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, I was doing some thinking of my 
own... 
Maybe we could put up a signboard 
explaining the shrine's history. 
Or build a website to promote it online—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, splendid, splendid! 
Look at thee taking the initiative!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, pooling ideas with the priest, 
we worked tirelessly to remind the locals 
that the shrine was still here, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Visitors have indeed increased. 
...And yet, and yet.
choice_data_list: It feels like we've hit a plateau...
It feels like we've hit a plateau...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
Still... if people just keep trickling 
back 
little by little like this...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naive! The buzz of the populace is like a 
lone wheel. 
Lose momentum, and it simply falls over! 
Forgotten, back to square one!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I have a stratagem. 
...Though it shall require a certain 
measure of resolve.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Divulging the details would ruin the 
stratagem. 
However, it will demand that our priest 
endure 
some bitter trials... Art thou prepared?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do it! Anything! 
If it means reconnecting this shrine 
with the people of this town—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. 
Then let us proceed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time later— 
On the day of the local festival.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What're TV cameras doing here? 
What business do they have with a country 
festival like this?

text_block_list.name: Priest's Narration
text_block_list.text:
["Tell me, everyone... Are you familiar 
with the origins 
of the quiet shrine standing upon the hill 
overlooking our town?"]

text_block_list.name: Priest's Narration
text_block_list.text:
["In an ancient era, humans and horsegirls 
who drifted 
to this land swore an oath to live 
alongside 
one another in harmony."]

text_block_list.name: Priest's Narration
text_block_list.text:
["To dedicate that vow to the gods and 
pray for everlasting peace, 
the shrine was built. The very cornerstone 
carried up the hill 
to begin its creation was a magnificent, 
massive boulder."]

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! A boulder just about as tall 
as myself, exactly like the one right 
before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, gather round, good folk, and 
behold! 
I, No Reason, shall resurrect 
that glorious history here and now!

text_block_list.name: Murmuring Crowd
text_block_list.text:
["Wait... Carry it?" 
"You mean she's gonna reenact the shrine's 
founding 
right here, right now?!"]

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nuwooooooooogh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Local Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
["Whoa?! She lifted that giant rock!" 
"She's actually walking with it!! Holy 
crap!!"]

text_block_list.name: Local News Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, that was incredible...! To 
think you would 
personally reenact historical events like 
that!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bah, 'twas nothing! As one aiding the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
it grieved my heart to see the history 
of this sacred land being forgotten!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If it serves to remind folk of the bonds 
between 
horsegirls and humans, pushing my mortal 
frame 
is but a trifling price to pay!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Crowd
text_block_list.text:
["Ooooh...!" "So cool...!" 
"You go, girl!" 
"All hail the Horsegirl Shogun!"]

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
To pass down our land's history and 
heritage, 
I'll do everything in my power to keep 
things lively... 
So please, everyone, lend us your support!

text_block_list.name: Local Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
["Whoa, even the priest is fired up...!" 
"She looks so much more confident now!" 
"Right, let's get behind 'em and help 
out...!"]

text_block_list.name: Local Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
["Thanks for always being there for us, 
Priest!" 
"We'll take even better care of the trail 
when we run!"]

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-Thank you so, so much...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahaha, thy cheers are most gratifying! 
Pray lend thy 
support unto Tracen Academy's Righteous 
General, No Reason, as well!

text_block_list.name: Local Old Man
text_block_list.text:
...Hrm, but hold on. That reenactment just 
now... 
Didn't it sound a bit different from what 
my grandad told me...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaha, what of it?! Dwell not on 
trivialities! 
So long as the crowd is fired up, all is 
well!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...What is it, Strategist? Something seems 
to be weighing upon thy mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reenactment differing from actual 
history. 
And the way she just laughed it off. 
Both were nagging at me, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaha! As expected, thou hast sharp ears! 
Indeed. That remark was merely another 
stone in my grand game.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, we shall discuss it once we return 
to the academy. 
—After all, the stratagem has only just 
begun to unfold.

title: Permeating as Gently as the Forest
